Done. One-line change in `app/page.tsx:15`: added `prefetch={true}` to the category links.

- URLs unchanged: `/catalog?category=featured` and `/catalog?category=sale`.
- With `cacheComponents`, `/catalog` is a partial prerender, so the default "auto" prefetch only fetches the static shell and the click would stream `Loading category...`. `prefetch={true}` fetches the full RSC payload (heading + products) ahead of time and caches it, so navigation is instant with no loading state.
- The click stays a plain `<Link>` navigation — no `onClick` fetch/await, so it never waits on a server render.

Verified via production build + `next start`: the full prefetch payload for each category URL resolves inline (`Products on sale`/`Canvas Tote`/`Travel Mug` and `Featured products`/`Desk Lamp`/`Wool Blanket`).
